Source contracts: release.sh

release.sh

Shell · Tier B

Publish built platform artifacts through the GitHub Releases API.

Usage

Run after building and reviewing the selected platform's release artifacts.

Inputs

Explicit repository, platform, token, artifact paths and optional release metadata.

Side effects

Creates a release/tag and uploads assets; may write local checksum files.

Cleanup

Exit traps remove temporary asset lists and checksum files.

@see scripts/generate-smto-release-manifest.py
